## Where I am
The Fernhill SAML ACS endpoint is finished: signature verification via signxml (python3-saml and xmlsec dropped), custom condition checks (audience, recipient, time window with 120 s skew), replay protection in Redis, and `saml_utils` moved to `api/auth/saml/verify.py`. All 36 auth tests and the full suite (1284 passed, 3 skipped) are green, lint and mypy clean. PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412 was opened and, per the facts, is now merged (commits 3f9c2a1, b71e04d, e0a5c93).

- [next-step] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, for the Thursday 10:00 New York demo.
- [next-step] Create the separate ticket to enforce SSO / disable password login for Fernhill users.
- [failed-attempt] python3-saml on Alpine failed: lxml/libxml2 version mismatch, then "cannot load crypto library for xmlsec" when building lxml from source; base-image switch was rejected because of image size.
- [failed-attempt] `gh pr merge 412 --squash` was refused by branch policy (needs one approving review); no `--admin` or `--auto` was used, and Maya was to be pinged directly.
- [decision] Use signxml instead of python3-saml, remove xmlsec from the Dockerfile, write the conditions checks ourselves, and read only from signed_xml (source: t08).
- [decision] Clock skew set to 120 s per the Fernhill security questionnaire; password login left untouched as a separate ticket (source: t12).
- [decision] No admin merge and no auto-merge (source: t21).
